title: Tenure Relief Schedule for RentGuard Discount-Stop Charges
content:
Stop relief for tenure applies to the charge owed on a RentGuard Renters Policy when its multi-policy discount stops. Tenure is measured in whole months from the renters original effective date — the first inception date shown on the renters policy — to today.

When the whole months from the renters original effective date to today are 60 or more, 15 relief points apply to the discount-stop charge; when they are 36 or more but fewer than 60, 5 relief points apply; when they are fewer than 36, no tenure relief points apply.

| Whole months since the renters original effective date | Relief points on the discount-stop charge |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 15 |
| 36 to 59 | 5 |
| 0 to 35 | 0 |

**Notes to the schedule.**

1. The count is of whole months only; a part month does not count.
2. At exactly 60 whole months the higher band applies (15 points); at 59 whole months the middle band applies (5 points).
3. At exactly 36 whole months the middle band applies (5 points); at 35 whole months no tenure relief points apply.
4. The original effective date is used, not the start of the current term, so renewals do not restart the count.

Hypothetical example: a renter first insured on 1 June five years ago, with today falling on 1 June, has 60 whole months and earns 15 relief points; with today falling on 31 May, 59 whole months, 5 relief points.
